pcs.pc_description: visit the Distributor Show Room, collect the new customer details, address, phone number etc. as per the days schedule and plan installation.
ensure the tool kit is ready with all the essential tools and replenish the required consumables.
ensure all the requisite details are printed on the documents carried.
carry ID card provided by Distributor at all times, and wear proper uniform while visiting the customer premises for installation.
ensure sufficient ventilation in the place where filled LPG cylinders are to be kept.
ensure that ventilation for cupboards is provided, if cylinders are placed in the cupboard
ensure sufficient space for keeping cylinder in vertical position only
ensure to stick the tear off slip with house- lock intimation on the customers main door if the house is locked, and inform the showroom supervisor accordingly
ensure availability of Fire Extinguishers (DCP / CO2), two buckets filled with water, two buckets filled with sand are available at Industrial and commercial Installation
ensure specification of Fire Extinguishers is as per IS 6044 (Part 1: 2000)
ensure to greet the customer
educate the customer on properties of LPG and safe usage of LPG equipment
avoid making noise while Installing and moving the cylinder in the house.
roll the cylinder on foot ring to the kitchen
ensure there are no other inflammable items in the kitchen and no open flames during installation.
ensure cylinders to be installed in vertical position with valve on top and safety cap tied on to the stay plate of the cylinder
ensure to place hot plate / stove at a higher level than the cylinder
ensure that there are no T-joints between cylinder and stove / hot plate
ensure cylinders are not installed or used below ground level, in cellar / basement
ensure no trolley is used for keeping cylinders in domestic / industrial installation
open the seal, connect the regulator with the cylinder and ensure that the regulator fits the cylinder properly
check for any leakage in the cylinder (from the joint and valve)
check the pressure regulator and rubber hose while installing the cylinder
ensure to switch on the regulator
switch on the gas stove to make sure that flame is ignited
in case of any leakage, remove the regulator, put on the safety cap on the valve of the cylinder, mark the cylinder as faulty and send it back to the Godown
in case of faulty O-ring, replace it
demonstrate the use with a live demo to the customer
switch off the knob of the gas stove and also the regulator

ensure all equipment such as pressure regulator and other installation material (industrial / commercial installation) comply with distributing companys stipulations and adhere to IS specifications, wherever applicable.
ensure BIS standards while carrying out installation for industrial purpose
ensure usage of ISI mark rubber tube without any cover / insulation
Ensure cylinders are installed at places which are free from overheating, proximity to steam pipes and boilers.
ensure cylinders are installed at places free from obstruction / prone for damage or vulnerable to unsafe conditions
ensure cylinders are placed at least 1 meter away from culverts / depressions / openings to prevent hazardous collection of gas
explain the safety instructions for using the LPG cylinder to the customer
provide details of emergency contacts and online complaint service to the customer
obtain the customers signature on the counter slip and retain the copy
update the serial number, date of installation in the customers book
communicate politely to the customer against unsafe practices
inform the customer about available ARB products at his distributorship
ensure to get the customer feedback, record the same and convey the same to the showroom staff
thank the customer before leaving
return the relevant documents/feedback form to showroom
create customer awareness regarding safe usage of LPG and allied equipment
conduct Safety Clinic on a weekly basis
ensure customer always use ISI mark hot plate and Suraksha LPG hose
educate customer on safe usage of LPG / LPG equipment (cylinder, valve, regulator, gas stove) during every visit, including installation & post installation
